title: Bounded CLI rendering and stream controls
question: Can a compact terminal report and a typed stdin/stdout exchange use the installed Rich and Typer pins without scratch files?
method: Render independently specified synthetic report shapes in memory and assert exact streams in subprocess pipe and stderr PTY controls, including SIGINT after live context entry.

results.name: Clean JSON stdout with pipe and stderr PTY
Cursor restored on SIGINT after context entry

conclusion: The pinned stack supports file-free typed pipe composition and a selected terminal summary. Explicit terminal policy is necessary because NO_COLOR still permits cursor control.
